impact: Initial screenshots that showed only the logo were taken with Chrome `--window-size=390`, but headless Chrome still used a 500px layout viewport and cropped the 390px image before the right-side controls. A true 390px mobile viewport keeps the theme and menu controls visible in the header.
resolution: Resolved as a verification artifact. CDP device metrics at 390x844 show `#theme-toggle-mobile` at x=290-326 and `#mobile-menu-btn` at x=334-370, both visible inside a 390px header. No code change required for the navigation controls.
title: Mobile navigation controls are not visible at narrow widths
